title: Contact
excerpt: Currently employed full-time at Zee Creative and available for select consulting, technical reviews, architecture guidance, and side projects.
body: I'm currently employed full-time as a Software Engineer at Zee Creative. I enjoy taking on select consulting engagements and side projects that complement my existing role.
For WordPress development, website redesigns, ADA remediation, real estate integrations, hosting, maintenance, and ongoing client work, please contact Zee Creative.
Working through Zee Creative provides access to the full agency team while allowing me to contribute my development expertise.
Contact Zee Creative

I'm available for carefully selected work that fits around my full-time commitments, including technical reviews, architecture guidance, specialized software projects, research collaboration, and technical writing.

• WordPress and CMS architecture
  • Data integration and automation
  • Software and systems engineering
  • AI workflow architecture
  • Accessibility and WCAG remediation
  • Security analysis and difficult technical troubleshooting
  • Open-source and research collaboration
Tell me what you're trying to accomplish and I'll point you toward the right path, whether that means working through Zee Creative or discussing a specialized independent engagement.
